name: SlideShowSettings
description: Represents the slide show setup for a presentation.
example:
For Each s In ActivePresentation.Slides

    With s.SlideShowTransition

        .AdvanceOnTime = True

        .AdvanceTime = 5

    End With

Next



With ActivePresentation.SlideShowSettings

    .RangeType = ppShowSlideRange

    .StartingSlide = 2

    .EndingSlide = 4

    .AdvanceMode = ppSlideShowUseSlideTimings

    .LoopUntilStopped = True

    .Run

End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: PointerColor
properties.description: Returns the pointer color for the specified presentation as a ColorFormat object. Read-only.

properties.name: NamedSlideShows
properties.description: Returns a NamedSlideShows collection that represents all the named slide shows (custom slide shows) in the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: StartingSlide
properties.description: Returns or sets the first slide to be displayed in the specified slide show. Read/write.

properties.name: EndingSlide
properties.description: Returns or sets the last slide to be displayed in the specified slide show. Read/write.

properties.name: AdvanceMode
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates how the slide show advances. Read/write.

properties.name: LoopUntilStopped
properties.description: Determines whether specified slide show loops continuously until the user presses ESC. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowType
properties.description: Returns or sets the show type for the specified slide show. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowWithNarration
properties.description: Determines whether the specified slide show is shown with narration. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowWithAnimation
properties.description: Determines whether the specified slide show displays shapes with assigned animation settings. Read/write.

properties.name: SlideShowName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the custom slide show to run in response to a mouse action on the shape during a slide show. Read/write.

properties.name: RangeType
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of slide show to run. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowScrollbar
properties.description: Determines whether to display the scroll bar during a slide show in browse mode. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowPresenterView
properties.description: Returns the presenter view of the SlideShowSettings object. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowMediaControls
properties.description: Allows access to the media controls in the SlideShowSettings object. Read/write.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Runs a slide show of the specified presentation. Returns a SlideShowWindow object.
